svg.title: Module 10 cheat sheet
svg.desc: The algorithm and the guarantee, the E and S formulas, the zoo, the bits ladder and the FP4 war, the assembly, the gotchas.
svg.text: Cheat sheet · Two levers and one measurement discipline

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace
g.text: accept with min(1, p/q) · rejection → norm((p−q)₊) · all γ accepted → the bonus · the emitted law ≡ p (a theorem)
the trace: α = Σ min(p,q) = 0.85 = 1 − TV(p,q) · the balance min(p,q) + (1−α)·resid = p ✓ (verified by Monte Carlo)
S = E/(1 + γc) · an external draft: γ* = 6 → 2.47× (flat)
MTP scenario: α=0.875, γ=1, c=0.05 → 1.79× (stated parameters)
γ = 1 ⇒ E ≤ 2 · hunt for α, not γ · S<1 when E<1+γc
EAGLE-3: direct token prediction with features fused from several layers
MTP: a native proposer for supported models; benefit is measured
risks: low α · expensive proposal · saturated load · incompatibility

svg.text: The bits ladder (8B, the M9 ceilings)

g.text: on the teaching outlier vector: the FP4-grid MSE is 3.3× lower
MR-GPTQ: format-aware PTQ; FP4 is not automatically better than INT4

svg.text: The FP4 war and the floors

g.text: NVFP4: E2M1 + E4M3 per 16 values + a global FP32 scale
MXFP4: E2M1 + E8M0 per 32 values; quality and speed depend on the stack
Command A+: reported W4A4 deployment on one B200 or two H100s

svg.text: wider verification → a 594 tok/s scenario · NVFP4-like payload + MTP scenario → 1,329 tok/s; both are upper estimates
quant + spec + serving + architecture can compose, but each step changes the bottleneck
the exact guarantee is w.r.t. the quantized model · group size alone does not identify a format · scenarios are upper estimates,
not benchmarks · developer results retain their conditions · decide from your own workload profile
the full version is §20 of the lecture; values reproduced by course verification code
